q: 昨天已经很热了，今天比昨天___热，大家都不想出门。
en: It was already hot yesterday, and today is even hotter than yesterday; nobody wants to go out.

q: 这个周末比上个周末___冷。
en: This weekend is colder than last weekend.

q: 虽然秋天早上已经很凉快，但是冬天早上比秋天___冷，我们只好穿羽绒服。
en: Autumn mornings are already cool, but winter mornings are even colder than autumn ones, so we had to put on down jackets.

q: 今年冬天比去年冷___，去年穿一件毛衣就够了，今年得穿羽绒服。
en: This winter is much colder than last winter; last year one sweater was enough, this year I need a down jacket.

q: 我家比朋友家离公司近___，只差五分钟的路。
en: My home is a bit closer to the office than my friend's; it is only five minutes' difference.

q: 我弟弟比我小___，他今年才十八。
en: My younger brother is three years younger than me; he is only eighteen this year.

q: 这家饭馆比那家便宜___，我们去这家吧。
en: This restaurant is ten yuan cheaper than that one; let's go to this one.

q: 听说下个月的天气会比这个月凉快___，到时候我们再约朋友去爬山吧。
en: I hear next month will be a bit cooler than this month; let's invite friends to go hiking then.

q: 今天___昨天那么冷，不用穿厚外套。
en: Today is not as cold as yesterday; you don't need a thick coat.

q: 今年的春天没有去年___暖和，花还没开呢。
en: This spring is not as warm as last spring; the flowers haven't bloomed yet.

q: 我跑得没有他___快，所以每次比赛都输。
en: I don't run as fast as he does, so I lose every race.

q: 虽然预报说有大雨，但是真正下起来，雨没有预报说的___大，我们还是出发了。
en: The forecast said heavy rain, but when it actually came, the rain was not as heavy as forecast, so we set off anyway.

q: 你说今天比昨天热？我觉得今天___昨天热，都是三十五度。
en: You say today is hotter than yesterday? I think today is no hotter than yesterday; both are thirty-five degrees.

q: 春天风太大了，出去玩还___在家看电影舒服。
en: The wind is too strong in spring; going out is not as pleasant as watching a film at home.

q: 他的汉语不如我___，所以他很羡慕我。
en: His Chinese is not as good as mine, so he envies me.

q: 今天的雨不如昨天___，路上不难走。
en: Today's rain is not as heavy as yesterday's; the road isn't hard to walk.

q: 你说秋天比春天舒服，可我觉得秋天___春天，我们这儿的秋天太干了。
en: You say autumn is more pleasant than spring, but I think autumn is not as good as spring; autumn here is too dry.

q: 我们这儿的冬天___北京一样冷，每年都下雪。
en: Winter here is as cold as in Beijing; it snows every year.

q: 今天的气温跟昨天一样___，出门最好带件外套。
en: Today's temperature is as low as yesterday's, so you had better take a jacket.

q: 这个春天和去年的春天___，都很暖和。
en: This spring is the same as last spring; both are warm.

q: 他跟他哥哥一点儿也___，性格完全不同。
en: He is nothing like his older brother; their personalities are completely different.

q: 在我们五个人当中，小李唱歌唱得___好，别人都比不上他。
en: Among the five of us, Xiao Li sings best; nobody else can match him.

q: 春天已经很舒服了，可是秋天___舒服，所以我最喜欢秋天。
en: Spring is already very pleasant, but autumn is even more pleasant, so I like autumn best.

q: 我们学校离地铁站___近，走路只要五分钟。
en: Our school is fairly close to the subway station; it takes only five minutes on foot.

q: 一年四季里，我___喜欢秋天，其他三个季节都比不上。
en: Of the four seasons I like autumn best; the other three can't compare.

q: 姐姐比我吃___多，可是她一点儿也不胖。
en: My older sister eats more than I do, yet she isn't fat at all.

q: 妹妹唱歌___得比我好听，大家都喜欢听她唱。
en: My younger sister sings better than I do; everyone likes listening to her.

q: 这个周末的聚会，小张到___比我们都早，一个人在门口等了很久。
en: At this weekend's get-together Xiao Zhang arrived earlier than all of us and waited alone at the door for a long time.

q: 他跑得___我快，所以第一个到终点的是他。
en: He runs faster than I do, so he was the first to reach the finish line.

q: 去年冬天的朋友聚会，小张唱歌唱___比我们每个人都好听，让大家都很惊讶。
en: At last winter's gathering of friends, Xiao Zhang sang better than any of us, which surprised everyone.

q: 天气越来越___了，该穿羽绒服了。
en: The weather is getting colder and colder; it is time to wear a down jacket.

q: 最近我们见面的机会越来越少___，大家都太忙了。
en: We have fewer and fewer chances to meet lately; everyone is too busy.

q: 他汉语说得越来越___，我们都为他高兴。
en: His Chinese is getting better and better, and we are all happy for him.

q: 他滑雪滑___越来越好了，今年冬天已经可以去高山了。
en: He skis better and better; this winter he can already go to the high mountains.
